name: Kanco Tea & Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Kanco Tea & Industries Ltd is in the business of Plantation, Manufacture and Sale of Black Teas.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company primarily produces black tea of crush, tear, curl (CTC) variety for selling in  domestic market through a mix of auction and private sales. KTIL’s three gardens in upper Assam are spread over 2,499 hectares, of which around 64% is under tea cultivation

pros: Stock is trading at 0.50 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.22% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.21% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.40 Cr.
